name: Kilnby · Gremlet #31
description:
A little clay pot that came alive after a hundred years on a shelf. Hollow eyes, warm heart.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Kilnby in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
